newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Istrabenz to move to main market.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Istrabenz to move to main market.

text.p: Petrol trader Istrabenz will be moved to the main market of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange from its current place on the over-the-counter (OTC) market, the bourse said on Monday.

The date for the move, made possible by the company's presentation of audited business results for the past three years, has yet to be determined but sources close to the bourse said it was likely to take place this month.
All 4.5 million Istrabenz shares, listed on the OTC in February and which represent 87.05 percent of the company's equity, will be moved.
Istrabenz is the Slovenian partner of Austria's oil and energy group OMV AG.
